annotations.title: What can I do with this property?

description: Use when someone asks what they can do with a specific property or address in Austin, TX or Nashville, TN: what it is zoned and what that means, how many homes the lot can take (Austin HOME rules, Texas SB 840 apartments on commercial land), what the zoning ordinance or Nashville Specific Plan says, whether a short-term rental (Airbnb) is allowed, the property tax and flood risk. Takes an address or a latitude and longitude. Returns the answer, the sources, a map link and a printable brief link. For a Nashville or Austin lot, when the paid Lot File is on sale in that city and covers the lot, it also returns lot_file: what the cited file adds (documents read, rules computed for the lot, pending cases) and the link to buy it.

address.description: Street address, for example '1600 E 6th St' or '1600 Division St, 37203'

appraised_value.description: Appraised value in dollars for the tax estimate (defaults: Austin 550000, Nashville 450000)

city.description: "austin" (City of Austin, Texas) or "nashville" (Nashville and Davidson County, Tennessee). Other cities are not covered.

homestead.description: Austin only: the owner's main home, so homestead exemptions apply (default true)

property_class.description: Nashville only: taxed as a home (25%) or a business (40%); default follows the zoning

name: land_at

lot.description: The lot's own records: size (Austin) or land use, building year, street frontage, service district and permit counts (Nashville)

lot_file.description: Nashville and Austin, when the file is on sale in that city and covers the lot's zoning: the paid Lot File for this lot, what it adds to this answer, and where to buy it

short_term_rentals.description: Owner-occupied and whole-home short-term rental answers for this spot, each with its reason and source

specific_plan.description: Nashville Specific Plan: what its ordinance says

status.description: ok: answered; choose: the address matches more than one place, choices lists them; not_found: no such address; no_zoning: the point is a street, water or outside the city; unsupported_city: not Austin or Nashville

what_you_can_build.description: Austin: how many homes the lot can take

zoning.description: The zoning code, what it means, overlays and the ordinance behind it

zoning_ordinances.description: Austin zoning ordinances covering the point, newest first
